name: The companion: a scripted follower
body: A companion entity whose movement is scripted, not pathfinding (`mechanics-design.md`, Companion Behaviour). World kind `companion_stop` with `order` and `wait_seconds` properties; she walks to the next stop when the player comes near the current one, and her wait shortens in later chapters.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's request to start using the Crimson and Thorn mechanics.
